text:
Honkai: Star Rail × Fate[UBW] Collab Trailer — "A Long Awaited Reunion"
"Hahahahaha! I don't care if you're a powerless goddess or a mage, hand over my Holy Grail!"
"You talk too much, Goldy! I'm super reliable when it matters~"
"Has anyone seen Lancer? Huh, what a familiar feeling..."

※ Special Note: The in-game voice-over language for the collaboration character is only available in Japanese, Chinese, and Korean. You can switch to other voice-over languages in-game, or navigate to Character Details →Information →Voice to individually switch the collaboration character's interaction, combat, and idle voices to the Fate[UBW] original licensed voice-over (Japanese).
